Prohibits the exportation of black sand and its derivatives in their raw form to other countries and requires all black sand mining or trading entities to only export processed products or raw materials that have undergone initial or advanced processing within the country.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FORENSIC DNA DATABASE IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to create a centralized and nationwide Forensic Deoxyribonucleic Acid (DNA) Database System for collection, storage, and maintenance of genetic identification information and to empower concerned government agencies to collect, analyze, type or profile, and record any genetic markers contained in or derived from DNA.
Intends to provide a reliable mechanism for building evidence in forensic investigations consisting of different indices:  to serve as a tool for crime prevention or solution, and non-criminal purposes;  to identify the person who got involved in the commission of an offense; to prove the innocence or guilt of person allegedly involved in the commission of an offense; to exonerate a person wrongly convicted of an offense, or to assist in the identification of missing persons or unidentified human remains.

rows.author: J071
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR AN OPT-IN MECHANISM FOR TELEPHONE AND MOBILE SUBSCRIBERS, PROTECTING SUCH SUBSCRIBERS FROM ELECTRONIC THREATS THROUGH THE MISUSE OF DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.abstract:
States that an “unsolicited call or text or spam” refers to any one of the following:  
1) not initiated by the recipient of the call or message containing commercial promotions or advertisements and did not opt-in to receive the same; 2) causes an installation of programs on the subscriber´s device without consent; 3) contains false or misleading electronic representations redirecting to websites, chat platforms, etc.,and 4) triggers the collection of personal information by accessing an electronic device illegally.
Proposes that:  as a default, all subscribers are automatically opted out of receiving unsolicited calls or texts; only subscriber who has given prior consent or has specifically opted-in shall receive commercial or promotional advertisements; and a subscriber who has opted-in may choose to opt-out any time.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2022-01-17

rows.title_short: Indigenous Community Conserved Territories And Areas Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to recognize and respect the designation and declaration by Indigenous Cultural Communities/Indigenous Peoples (ICCs/IPs) of the conserved areas within their ancestral domains and to promote their rights to manage, maintain, and sustainably develop the natural resources by applying their indigenous knowledge systems and practices within these areas under their indigenous political structures and traditional governance systems.

Provides a Registry which shall be the official information management system that shall contain all pertinent records on the Indigenous Community Conserved Territories and Areas (ICCAs) that are voluntarily submitted by the ICCs/Ips as the ICCA registrant.

rows.title_full: AN ACT FOR THE STEWARDSHIP AND CONSERVATION OF BUILT CULTURAL HERITAGE
rows.abstract:
Defines “Built Heritage” as an architectural and engineering structures such as, but not limited to bridges, government buildings, houses of ancestry, traditional dwellings, quartels, train stations, lighthouses, small ports, educational, technological, and industrial complexes, and their settings, and landscapes with notable historical and cultural significance.
Intends to:  integrate existing legislation on heritage protection with local government mandates, especially concerning land use planning and permitting functions; provide financial incentives to encourage property owners to preserve their structures; and to properly define the jurisdiction borders between cultural agencies, and develop their institutional capacity.

rows.abstract:

Creates the Regional Investment and Infrastructure Coordinating Hub of Central Luzon (RICH) which shall replace the Subic-Clark Alliance for Development Council (SCADC) which powers shall be vested by the Board of Directors composed of thirteen (13) Members.  

Mandates the Board to develop the Central Luzon Investment Corridor Master Plan (Master Plan) which shall contain the necessary programs and strategies to ensure the harmonious operation of an aggregation of special economic or freeport zones within Central Luzon.

rows.abstract:
Refers "public green spaces" to an open area of grass, trees, or other vegetation set apart for leisure, recreational, or aesthetic purposes for the general public.

Proposes that public green spaces include but are not limited to permanent forests, tree parks, or watersheds with an aggregate size equivalent to at least two percent (2%) of its entire area, and may be located in one or more places within the LGU´s respective jurisdiction.

rows.title_full: AN ACT  REGULATING THE USE OF BANK ACCOUNTS, ELECTRONIC WALLETS, AND OTHER FINANCIAL ACCOUNTS
rows.title_short: Financial Accounts Regulation Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to protect the public from cybercriminals and criminal syndicates who target bank accounts and e-wallets or lure account holders into perpetrating fraudulent activities.

Enumerates and defines punishable offenses such as money mule, social engineering schemes and economic sabotage. Declares that the commission of certain crimes when done in bulk or in large scale is a form of economic sabotage and a heinous crime and shall be punishable to the maximum level allowed by law.
